name: Craig Goldman
bio: a Representative from Texas; born in Texas, October 3, 1968; graduated from Trinity Valley School, Fort Worth, Tex., 1987; B.A., University of Texas at Austin, Austin, Tex., 1991; business owner; staff, National Republican Senatorial Committee; staff, presidential campaign of United States Senator John Sidney McCain III; member of the Texas state house of representatives, 2013-2025; elected as a Republican to the One Hundred Nineteenth Congress (January 3, 2025-present).
